source: ESPN public injury report and game summaries

injuries.name: Moritz Wagner
injuries.short_comment: Wagner (knee) won't be available for Friday's game against Toronto.
injuries.long_comment: Wagner suffered an injury Wednesday against the Bucks and won't be an option Friday. His status for the second leg of the back-to-back set Saturday at Charlotte is uncertain.

injuries.name: Nolan Traore
injuries.short_comment: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
injuries.long_comment: Traore had a productive start to his second year in the NBA, though he's now set to miss an extended period after sustaining a hamstring injury in Friday's loss to Orlando. With the 20-year-old point guard sidelined, Egor Demin, Mikel Brown and Keon Ellis are candidates for increased playing time.

injuries.name: RJ Barrett
injuries.short_comment: Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
injuries.long_comment: Based on his re-evaluation timeline, Barrett likely won't return to game action until mid-December at the earliest. Jamison Battle, Allen Graves and Jamal Shead are candidates for increased playing time in Barrett's absence, especially while Kawhi Leonard (knee) is also sidelined.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.short_comment: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
injuries.long_comment: Bittle continues to work his way back from a fractured right foot, as he's yet to make his 2026-27 season debut. He remains week-to-week until Toronto provides a definitive update.

injuries.name: Alijah Martin
injuries.short_comment: Martin is questionable for Friday's game against the Nets due to left knee soreness.
injuries.long_comment: A decision on Martin's availability will be made closer to Friday's 7:30 p.m. tip-off, but his status shouldn't cause a big impact in most fantasy formats. He's averaging just 0.8 points and 2.2 rebounds on 12.2 minutes per game off the bench over his last five appearances.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.short_comment: Leonard has begun individual on-court workouts following treatment to address swelling in his left knee, and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.long_comment: Leonard continues to progress in his recovery, and the Raptors are expected to provide another update in a week. Collin Murray-Boyles and Allen Graves will likely continue seeing increased burn for as long as Leonard is sidelined.
